basis: Documentation review; no hands-on performance benchmark

facts.summary: Volleyball family and team match-day scoring and sharing.
facts.limit: Published by CourtsideView. This is a documentation review, not a hands-on benchmark.

facts.summary: Scorekeeper supports rally scores, sets and timeouts.
facts.limit: Confirm the format and settings before a match. Event acceptance is a separate requirement.

facts.summary: Player statistics, rotations and rosters are documented features.
facts.limit: Registration is required for features beyond guest Scorekeeper.

facts.summary: FanView shares live scores, match activity and optional live video. Fans can view in a browser without installing the app.
facts.limit: Registered accounts are required for FanView viewing and broadcasting. Live sharing needs internet.

facts.summary: Downloads for iPhone, iPad and Android. Guest use is limited to Scorekeeper.
facts.limit: Other features require registration. Check current store compatibility for the device you plan to use.

facts.summary: Free to download.
facts.limit: Free download does not establish that every feature is always free. Check current feature access and store terms.

facts.summary: Multi-sport team platform with volleyball scoring, statistics, communication and streaming.
facts.limit: Check the workflow for your team role and sport.

facts.summary: Volleyball point entry, player attribution, play editing and a Stats tab are documented.
facts.limit: Team access and scorer permissions affect who can score and edit.

facts.summary: Volleyball box scores, player attribution and season context are documented.
facts.limit: Some parent/fan features require a subscription.

facts.summary: Live volleyball streaming and viewing are documented. Volleyball live viewing is free.
facts.limit: The broadcaster selects the audience. Free live viewing does not make all replays, clips or fan features free.

facts.summary: Scoring and broadcast actions use the GameChanger app and team roles.
facts.limit: Confirm account, audience, device and permission requirements for your exact workflow.

facts.summary: Free download. Coaches/staff use team features free; additional fan features may require a subscription.
facts.limit: Check current fan pricing and included features. Volleyball live viewing remains distinct from paid extras.

facts.summary: Coach-focused volleyball stat capture and analysis.
facts.limit: Choose the specific SoloStats app and plan that fits your task.

facts.summary: SoloStats Live documents in-rally volleyball scorekeeping.
facts.limit: Try the entry method before relying on it at a live match.

facts.summary: Apps document player actions and rotations. WebReports adds aggregated analysis and exports.
facts.limit: Reporting and multi-device features depend on plan.

facts.summary: Offline stat capture is documented.
facts.limit: Confirm platform, account and sync requirements for the chosen app. Shared/cloud workflows may need internet.

facts.summary: Free stat capture is offered; Standard and Pro plans add reporting and other features.
